title: xychart: support for multiple datasets added
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Currently the `xychart` does not support multiple datasets which is a very common requirement. I also need it myself for a software package which uses `mermaid`. Therefore I have implemented support for multiple datasets while staying compatible with existing usages.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

There were not really any design changes required. For changes to parser syntax please have a look at `demos/xychart.html`.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

comments.author: subhash-halder
comments.body:
There is one issue if we remove the y-axis config then the y-axis should auto-calculate to the proper range. please check the below example, the plot is going above the chart canvas.
![image](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/assets/7448177/791be919-309d-468c-bbb9-97af2e990f13)

```xychart-beta
      title "Basic xychart with multiple datasets"
      x-axis "Relevant categories" [category1, "category 2", category3, category4]
      bar "dogs" [40, 20, 40, 30]
      bar "cats" [20, 40, 50, 30]
      bar "birds" [30, 60, 50, 30]

comments.author: camueller
subhash-halder
comments.body:
@camueller We are using d3-axis to calculate the tick to display, and to get the scale we passed the min and max and the d3-axis decides which ticks to draw.
I think how d3-axis decides is if it can create the tick with a multiple of 5 then it uses that as it is more easily relatable to humans.

in this case, we need to update the setting of min max accordingly if there is multiple bar charts from here
https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/05e17c0bf08d99810321b07710d62adff1be3673/packages/mermaid/src/diagrams/xychart/xychartDb.ts#L112

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Identifies a bug where removing y-axis config causes the plot to render beyond the chart canvas, implying the auto-calculation logic needs to be fixed.
